conceptZh: 廚師動物的擀麵棍自己做出一個鬼臉麵團，嚇得大廚帽子飛起來，最後被牠收服。
object: a rotund chef badger with a rebellious rolling pin
morph: a defiant rolling pin flattens dough strokes into 怕 and a silly dough ghost
creativeAngle: 道具反抗：擀麵棍自己玩，大廚先怕後笑。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a soft lemon background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 怕 as the only text on screen, drawn in grape purple solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a plump badger chef in a tall hat hurls pizza dough with big confidence and it lands as the left heart radical on the board; the first 怕 is spoken as the three small dots of the radical splat down. 1.7-3.4s: the rolling pin jumps out of his paws and flattens a blob into a goofy ghost face, so the chef hops back and his hat pops off; the second 怕 is spoken as the white 白 dough shape flops next to the radical. 3.4-5s: he traps the pin under a mixing bowl with a clever flick; 怕怕 is spoken as the little dough ghost peeks around the glyph, wobbles, and sticks out a tongue while the chef hides behind his hat and then bursts into giggles. 5-8s: hold; the chef puts the hat back on and bows, the glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "怕、怕、怕怕" (ㄆㄚˋ、ㄆㄚˋ、ㄆㄚˋ ㄆㄚˋ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 怕 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
